name: Small demersal fish
description: Small bottom-living fishes: the coastal-S group (gobies, sand-smelts), the shelf-S group (small shelf fish such as lizardfishes and sea-snails) and the shelf soles (flatfishes). Functional group pooling the source's Coastal S, Shelf S and Shelf soles compartments - the guild of small benthic-feeding demersals that turn worms, molluscs and meiobenthos into food for bigger fish and cephalopods; pooled to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
